resources.title: Evaluation Metrics & Model Diagnosis Cheat Sheet
resources.description: A one-page reference pulling together the confusion matrix, accuracy/precision/recall/F1, the overfitting-vs-underfitting diagnostic table, and the train/validation/test rule into a single sheet you can keep open while evaluating any model — includes a worked read-through of the capstone's own 0.982-accuracy result.

resources.title: ML Model Selection Quick Reference
resources.description: A side-by-side comparison table of linear regression, classification, decision trees/ensembles, and neural networks — what each predicts, how fast it trains, how interpretable it is, and when to actually reach for it — plus the minimal scikit-learn code pattern for each.

resources.title: Messy Customer Signups Dataset (Raw, for Cleaning Practice)
resources.description: A 25-row raw CSV export in the same shape as Lesson 12's own before/after example, extended into a full practice dataset: an exact duplicate row, mixed date formats, inconsistent plan-name casing, impossible ages and negative spend values, disguised missing values (N/A, unknown, blank), and a cancellation_request_date column that is a genuine target-leakage trap — it's only ever populated for customers who already churned.

resources.title: Hugging Face Model Selection Checklist
resources.description: A fill-in worksheet version of Chapter 5's six-signal model-selection checklist (task match, license, usage, eval results, paper/citations, base-model lineage), paired with the two-line loading pattern, the pipeline() shortcut, and a short fine-tune-vs-as-is decision guide.
